definitions.pooled_rmse: sqrt(mean(error squared over all selected episodes and future times)); excludes anchor
definitions.mean_episode_rmse: mean over episodes of sqrt(mean time error squared); matches original report and differs from pooled_rmse
definitions.equilibrium_reference_rms: RMSE of always theta=0, omega=0; angle denominator uses wrap(true theta), not unwrapped multi-turn angle
definitions.nrmse: pooled_rmse / equilibrium_reference_rms; values below1 beat the equilibrium predictor,1 tie,above1 worse
definitions.mse_skill_vs_equilibrium: 1 - nrmse squared; zero ties equilibrium,positive improves,negative worsens
definitions.oracle_true_initial_state_persistence: constant true theta/omega at anchor; privileged diagnostic, not a visually initialized competing learned model
definitions.seed_aggregation: Each seed contributes one metric; mean and sample SD across3 seeds, including readout randomness
definitions.normalization_boundary: Condition/horizon test-truth RMS is a post-hoc descriptive scale, not a training statistic or a replacement primary metric. For future prespecified comparisons, additionally use a common scale fixed from training data and report absolute RMSE plus baseline skill.
definitions.pointwise_relative_error: Not used: theta and omega cross zero and decay toward zero, so per-time division is singular or unstable.
definitions.paired_design_boundary: Same test episode IDs and data-seed configuration across damping; anchor is0.4s after initialization and therefore its true state already differs with damping.
